Population abundance per batch

Source: R/clinical.R
fig_populations_by_batch.Rd

WHY THIS EXISTS SEPARATELY from the batch diagnostics. Those ask whether the EMBEDDING separates by batch, which is a question about the cells. This asks whether the reported numbers differ by batch, which is a question about the result: a population that shifts with acquisition batch is a population whose between-group difference may be an acquisition difference.

Usage

fig_populations_by_batch(
  freq,
  batch_of,
  outfile,
  value_col = NULL,
  ncol = 4L,
  dpi = 200,
  colors = fcs_colors()
)

Arguments

freq

population_frequencies table.

batch_of

named vector sample_id -> batch.

outfile

path.

value_col

frequency column.

ncol

panels per row.

dpi

resolution.

colors

palette.
